Diff layout experiment

Same Press fences, four ways of showing a change. Overlay is what Press does today. Independent split is two ordinary diagrams. Aligned split reuses the overlay layout and hides one side. Ghost keeps the missing side faded in place.

Order lifecycle: a fraud check before payment

state-machine

1. Overlay — one figure, both sides, colour for change

2. Independent split — two compact diagrams, no +/- paint

Before

After

3. Independent split, still marked

Before (− kept)

After (+ kept)

4. Aligned split — same overlay layout, other side hidden

Before (added hidden)

After (removed hidden)

Changed nodes stay on both panels with the after label and a “was …” note. CSS cannot recover the before label.

5. Ghost — same layout, other side faded

Before (added ghosted)

After (removed ghosted)
